texts.zh:
将意志投射在虚境中，我们在一定程度上驾驭了灵能力量。我们可以在从各个灵域的无数实体身上汲取能量，却又不受它们的影响；不仅如此，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]还能完美地控制灵能出神了。

其他人让自己的命运任由虚境摆布时，我们已经得到了真正的意志自由。

[this.GetName]已经解放了全部的灵能潜力。
texts.en:
By projecting our will into the Shroud, we have attained a degree of mastery over our psionic abilities. We have gathered power from the domains of numerous entities, while remaining unbound by their influence; furthermore, our [GetTelepathPlural] now possess expert control over their psionic trances.

Where others may have let the Shroud itself forge their destiny, we have maintained true independence of will.

The psionic potential of the [this.GetName] has been fulfilled.
